{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with non-numeric revenue (i.e., NaN after conversion)
non_numeric_rows = df[df['revenue'].isna()]

# Check which of these are 'completed' orders
non_numeric_completed = non_numeric_rows[non_numeric_rows['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the number of such rows and their revenue values
len(non_numeric_completed), non_numeric_completed[['order_id', 'revenue', 'status']].head()"}
